title: Sparse relation circular proposal distinctness corrective V1
purpose: Verify that the fixed six-token capacity cannot emit multiple proposal tokens inside one frozen local-support neighborhood.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training corrective on the same eight fit observations plus synthetic wrap cases; no validation/test/optimizer/checkpoint/graph.
approval.confirmation_reference: User authorized continuous evidence-optimal method corrections.

raw_sources: Same eight fixed C01-C03 observations used by sealed readiness.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.audit_scope: Eight fixed fit observations/34 frames and deterministic synthetic circular fields.

sampling.rule: Reuse fixed rows; proposal separation radius is exactly the already frozen soft-support radius of four bins.

teacher.source: Objective branch fields only for the unchanged real loss.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: NMS consumes predicted logits only; no identity, pose, graph or future input.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Fit rows only; sealed prior result is provenance.

methods.main: Replace unconstrained top-6 with deterministic circular non-maximum suppression using the existing four-bin soft-support radius. Verify minimum pairwise separation greater than four bins, wrap/rotation equivariance and unchanged full real backward.
methods.baseline: Unconstrained top-6 could select adjacent bins from one physical opening.
methods.fallback: Any distinctness, rotation or loss failure stops training; no new radius or prediction threshold.

failure_policy: No optimizer/checkpoint/C07-C10/M-TARE/graph/planner. Any radius, wrap, finite-gradient or source failure stops.
retention: Retain synthetic/real distinctness, losses, invariants, figures/source, CSV, environment, logs, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: One deterministic CUDA real forward/backward plus synthetic checks
